subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history store, and through which supported boundary?
rationale: The fix is not just a local code patch: maintainers need to choose whether OpenClaw may write third-party Open WebUI state directly, use a supported Open WebUI API/integration boundary, require operator opt-in configuration, and handle historical backfill.

options.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Add an operator-enabled sync path with schema/API version handling, docs, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Keep OpenClaw transcript/model context as the owned source and document that Control UI sends do not update Open WebUI visible history.

options.title: Route to plugin or integration seam
options.body: Keep core unchanged unless a plugin/API extension is needed to support this external sync safely outside core.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Add an operator-enabled sync path with schema/API version handling, docs, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on Gateway chat persistence, Open WebUI smoke coverage, and the adjacent webchat persistence boundary.
